metadata_fields.description: Facts an asset of this class may carry. Decimals are sent as strings.
metadata_fields.title: Metadata Fields

valuation_mode.description: `market`: valued from prices. `manual`: valued from user-entered valuations.
valuation_mode.title: Valuation Mode

AssetCreate.description:
A user-defined asset (a property, a private business, a SACCO share). Only its creator sees
it. Listed instruments come from market data providers, not from this endpoint.
AssetCreate.title: AssetCreate

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the asset is priced or valued in
currency.title: Currency

is_custom.description: True for an asset the caller defined (only they see it)
is_custom.title: Is Custom

metadata.description: Type-specific facts. Decimals are strings, dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
metadata.title: Metadata

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the asset is priced or valued in
currency.title: Currency

is_custom.description: True for an asset the caller defined (only they see it)
is_custom.title: Is Custom

as_of.description: When the rate was valid (the provider's timestamp)
as_of.title: As Of

inverted.description: Derived as 1 / rate from the opposite pair
inverted.title: Inverted

rate.description: 1 unit of base_currency in quote_currency units
rate.title: Rate

rule.description: `historical`: the rate for the given date; `latest`: the most recent rate
rule.title: Rule

stale.description: Older than one day (provisional threshold, DEC-26)
stale.title: Stale

HoldingOut.description:
A position derived from the ledger (weighted average cost, ADR-0012). Money is in the
portfolio's base currency, converted at each posting's own rate.

average_cost.description: Cost per unit (up to 8 decimals); null when no units are held

expenses.description: Fees and taxes charged to the asset, incl. withholding

income.description: Dividends, coupons, rent, distributions and interest

realized_pl.description: Profit or loss realised by sales

HoldingOut.title: HoldingOut

Money.description:
An amount in a currency. The amount is a string, written with the currency's minor units
in responses ("1234.50", "1500" for JPY).
Money.title: Money

base_currency.description: ISO 4217. Fixed once the portfolio exists: postings are converted into it.
base_currency.title: Base Currency

archived_at.description: Set when archived; archived is read-only
archived_at.title: Archived At

PortfolioUpdate.description: PATCH body: any subset. The base currency cannot change.
PortfolioUpdate.title: PortfolioUpdate

Preferences.description: UI preferences stored for the user. Unknown keys are rejected.
Preferences.title: Preferences

PreferencesUpdate.description:
PATCH body: any subset of the fields below. Omitted fields keep their value; sending null
clears a UI preference.
PreferencesUpdate.title: PreferencesUpdate

RiskProfileUpdate.description: Corrects a self-assessment. Omitted fields keep their value.
RiskProfileUpdate.title: RiskProfileUpdate

TransactionCreate.description:
A ledger posting. See `app/modules/transactions/rules.py` for the rules per type. Amounts
are Money objects in the posting `currency`; quantities and rates are strings.

fx_rate_as_of.description: When the rate was valid (with a time zone)
fx_rate_as_of.title: Fx Rate As Of

fx_rate_to_portfolio_currency.description: 1 unit of the posting currency in portfolio currency units. Required when the posting currency differs from the portfolio's.
fx_rate_to_portfolio_currency.title: Fx Rate To Portfolio Currency

gross_amount.description: For BUY/SELL derived from quantity x unit price when omitted

TransactionCreate.title: TransactionCreate

reversed_by_transaction_id.description: Set when this entry has been cancelled by a reversal
reversed_by_transaction_id.title: Reversed By Transaction Id

reverses_transaction_id.description: Set on a reversal: the entry it cancels
reverses_transaction_id.title: Reverses Transaction Id

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null at the end
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

HTTPBearer.description: OIDC access token from the WealthSphere realm
